using-dualcraft: DualCraft workflow - project context from the brain, work mode before working, capture out-of-scope work, route to the right dualcraft skill. Use at the start of any conversation in a project with a .dualcraft/ folder or when DualCraft is mentioned.
help: Lists DualCraft commands by pack, installed or not. Use for /dualcraft:help, "¿qué comandos hay?", "qué puedo hacer con dualcraft".
new-project: New project from zero - intake form (idea, platforms, stacks, backend, design, MVP) → brief, decisions, tasks, functional doc and scaffolding. Use for "nuevo proyecto", "empezamos de cero", or in an empty folder.
stacks: Supported stacks (Next.js, React+Vite, Astro, Nuxt, Flutter, React Native, KMP, Android, iOS) and adding one to the project. Use for "¿qué tecnologías soporta?", "añade una app/web al proyecto".
start: Starts work - sets up .dualcraft the first time, loads context and asks the work mode (bug, new development, refactor) before any code. Use for "empezamos", "quiero hacer X", or when the work mode is not chosen.
commit: Conventional Commits from the work mode, linked to brain ids, with CHANGELOG; asks first, never pushes unasked. Use for "haz commit", "commitea", "sube los cambios", or when verified work is done.
brain: Project brain - tasks, bugs, notes and ideas with dependencies and target versions. Use for "apunta", "déjalo para luego", "¿qué tenemos pendiente?", "backlog", or when out-of-scope work comes up.
decisions: Project decisions (ADR) - record, list by area, check conflicts, supersede with history. Use for "hemos decidido", "a partir de ahora", "¿qué decidimos sobre…?", "cambiamos de idea", or when a request contradicts a decision.
park: Parks finished work for a later version (parked branch or feature flag) and resumes it later. Use for "déjalo para la siguiente versión", "apárcalo", "no lo metas en esta versión", "¿qué hay aparcado?".
map: Visual map of the brain - notes as nodes, dependencies as arrows, filters and detail panel (also roadmap view). Use for "enséñame el mapa", "qué depende de qué", "ver el brain".
roadmap: Roadmap by target version with progress, blocked and parked items, as a board or a chat summary. Use for "roadmap", "¿qué entra en la próxima versión?", "qué falta para la 1.3".
brainstorm: Explores an idea before building it (goal, flows per platform, data, edge cases, options) into an agreed design. Use before code in new development, or for "tengo una idea", "quiero añadir…", "¿cómo lo hacemos?".
plan: Written implementation plan (small steps, exact files, tests first, checks) saved and executed step by step. Use for multi-step or cross-platform work, after a brainstorm, or "sigue con el plan".
tdd: Test first, watch it fail, minimum code to pass, refactor green; same cases on every platform. Use before writing implementation code, or for "con tests", "hazlo con TDD".
debug: Root cause before any fix - reproduce, gather evidence, test hypotheses, fix the cause, check the other platform. Use for any bug, crash or failing test, "no funciona", or when a fix did not work.
verify: Evidence before saying done - analyzer, types, lint, tests, build and decision checks per affected platform. Use before saying work is finished, committing or closing a task, or for "¿funciona?".
review: Code review - correctness, lifecycle, web/mobile consistency, decisions, tokens, security, accessibility - ranked findings with file:line. Use for "revisa el código", "¿está bien esto?", or before merging.
docs: Functional document (docs/FUNCTIONAL.md) kept current per feature and platform, traceable to brain ids. Use for "documento funcional", "documenta esto", "¿qué hace la app?", or after a verified feature.
web-architecture: Maps the web app structure (Next.js, React+Vite, Astro, Nuxt) and says where each change goes. Use for "¿dónde va esto en la web?", "cómo está organizada la web", or before a new page.
web-build: Builds the web app and fixes build problems - dependencies, upgrades, types, lint, env vars, deploy builds. Use for "no compila la web", "falla el build", "actualiza Next/React", "instala X en la web".
web-test: Web tests - unit, components, route handlers, e2e - right level, proper mocks, setup if missing. Use for "tests de la web", "añade tests a este componente", "e2e", or when TDD needs a web test.
web-browser: Runs the web app in a browser - screenshots at desktop and mobile widths, console errors, flows, comparison with designs. Use for "ábrela en el navegador", "mira cómo se ve la web", "haz captura".
web-seo: SEO and performance - metadata, sitemap, canonical, hreflang, structured data, Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse. Use for "SEO", "posicionamiento", "Google no indexa", "la web va lenta", or before public pages.
mobile-architecture: Maps the mobile app structure (Flutter, React Native, KMP, Android, iOS) and says where each change goes. Use for "¿dónde va esto en la app?", "cómo está organizada la app", or before a new screen.
mobile-build: Builds the mobile app and fixes build problems - dependencies, Gradle, pods, flavors, codegen, signing, store builds. Use for "no compila la app", "falla Gradle", "error de pods", "genera el appbundle".
mobile-test: Mobile tests - unit, widget/component, golden, integration - with fakes for Firebase and plugins. Use for "tests de la app", "test de este widget", "integration test", or when TDD needs a mobile test.
mobile-device: Emulators and devices - start, install, run, screenshots, logs, deep links, adb UI automation, permissions. Use for "arranca el emulador", "instala la app", "captura del móvil", "mira los logs".
mobile-crash: Crash analysis from stack traces, logcat, iOS logs, Crashlytics or Sentry to the root cause in code. Use when a trace or crash report is shared, or for "la app se cierra", "crash", "ANR", "pantalla roja".
refactor-web: Safe web refactoring without behaviour change - components, server/client split, data fetching, duplication, dead code - in small green steps. Use for "refactoriza la web", "limpia este componente".
refactor-mobile: Safe mobile refactoring without behaviour change - widget/screen decomposition, state, repositories, lifecycle, duplication - in small green steps. Use for "refactoriza la app", "este widget es enorme".
refactor-global: Cross-platform refactoring - business rules duplicated or drifting between web and mobile moved to one place or shared test cases. Use for "unifica web y app", "esto está duplicado", "no hacen lo mismo".
i18n: Texts from one source (ICU) generated for every stack; missing keys, hard-coded strings, new languages. Use for "traduce", "añade inglés", "textos sin traducir", "cambia este texto".
analytics: Tracking plan (.dualcraft/analytics/events.json) validated and generated as typed helpers for every stack, with coverage per platform. Use for "analítica", "eventos", "quiero medir…", "¿estamos midiendo X?".
schema: Database schema (.dualcraft/db/schema.dbml) as the single source of truth → models for every stack and Firestore rules. Use when defining or changing stored data, or for "saca el modelo de datos del código".
er: ER diagram of the schema - tables, crow's-foot relations, drag, PNG/SVG export. Use for "enséñame el modelo de datos", "diagrama de la base de datos", "esquema ER".
database: Creates the database and environments (Firebase, Supabase, Postgres+Prisma; local, dev, prod) with each CLI, migrations with RLS and safe promotion to prod. Use for "crea la base de datos", "configura Supabase", "aplica la migración".
backend: Serverless backend from one contract - Firebase Cloud Functions, Supabase Edge Functions or API routes: callables, webhooks, triggers, cron, server validation and typed clients per stack. Use for "crea una función", "endpoint", "webhook", "cron", "backend".
payments: In-app purchases on Google Play and the App Store from one catalog - subscriptions, unlocks, consumables; server verification and store notifications, or RevenueCat; typed catalogs per stack. Use for "compras in-app", "suscripción", "premium", "RevenueCat".
push: Push notifications with FCM (Android, iOS, web) from one catalog - channels, topics, typed notifications with deep links, texts per device language, registration, typed senders and parsers per stack. Use for "notificaciones push", "avisar al usuario", "FCM".
deploy: CI/CD with GitHub Actions per stack - web deploys (Firebase Hosting, Vercel, Cloudflare, Netlify) with PR previews, backend deploys, Play internal and TestFlight on tags, environments, secrets, signing. Use for "CI", "deploy", "despliegue", "subir a TestFlight".
auth: Authentication on Firebase or Supabase from one config - email, Google, Apple, phone, passkeys, guest, 2FA, roles and route rules, account deletion; typed AuthService and screens per stack. Use for "login", "registro", "roles", "borrar cuenta", "passkeys".
e2e: End-to-end tests from one spec - Playwright (web) with axe accessibility checks and Maestro (apps), flows derived from auth, routes, payments and screenshots, web in CI. Use for "tests e2e", "Playwright", "Maestro", "prueba el login entero", "accesibilidad".
perf: Performance budgets checked in CI - Lighthouse Core Web Vitals and bundle size per route, store build size, app cold start with history. Use for "rendimiento", "la web va lenta", "Lighthouse", "la app pesa mucho", "arranque".
video: Marketing videos with Remotion from one spec - App Store previews, Play promo, Reels/TikTok and feed, per language, from the DS tokens, screenshots and release notes; rendered locally. Use for "vídeo", "Remotion", "app preview", "reel de la versión".
legal: EU/Spain privacy for apps and webs - data map from SDKs and schema, drafts of privacy, terms and cookie policies, App Store privacy, Data safety, iOS privacy manifest; checks deletion, ATT, consent. Use for "privacidad", "RGPD", "cookies", "data safety".
design-system: Creates the project's claude.ai Design System (brand interview or from code), links it and pulls its tokens. Use for "crea el design system", "define la marca, colores o tipografía".
tokens: Pulls Design System tokens, checks WCAG contrast and generates theme code for every stack. Use for "actualiza los colores", "sincroniza el diseño", or when generated tokens are missing or stale.
design-screen: Designs a screen in the claude.ai Design canvas as mobile and web artboards with its states, using the design system. Use for "diseña la pantalla de…", "haz un mockup", "cómo se vería…".
design-to-code: Implements a designed screen with tokens only, existing components, accessibility and i18n, compared with the artboard. Use for "pasa este diseño a código", "implementa la pantalla de…", "maqueta esto".
security-global: Full security audit - threat model, scanner, rules vs schema, functions, payments, abuse, privacy - with a dated report and brain bugs. Use for "auditoría de seguridad", "¿es segura la app?", before launch.
security-web: Web security review - auth, every endpoint and server action, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, headers and CSP, secrets. Use for "seguridad de la web", "¿es segura esta API?", or within a global audit.
security-mobile: Mobile security review (MASVS) - storage, network, deep links, manifest and ATS, release config, IAP verification, App Check. Use for "seguridad de la app", before a store release, or in a global audit.
release: Closes and ships a version - readiness checklist, version bump everywhere, CHANGELOG, tag, store notes per language, follow-up. Use for "saca la versión", "cerramos la 1.3", "vamos a publicar".
marketing: What to communicate in each update and ready copy - stores and ASO, web, social, in-app, push, email - with campaign plan and metrics. Use for "ideas de marketing", "cómo anunciamos esta versión", "ASO".
convert: Converts between stacks (web ⇄ mobile, or migrations) feature by feature - inventory, backend decisions with the user, neutral spec, native adaptation, verification. Use for "pasa la web a app", "haz la versión web", "migra a Flutter".
port: Deep code conversion between Dart, Kotlin, Swift and TypeScript (Flutter, Compose, KMP, SwiftUI, React Native) - idioms, dependency mapping, file plan, parity checks. Use for "pasa la app de Flutter a Kotlin", "convierte a Swift", "migra a KMP".
github: Syncs the brain with GitHub Issues - tasks and bugs as issues, versions as milestones, assignees, closing and importing. Use for "sube las tareas a GitHub", "sincroniza con GitHub", "asigna esta tarea a…".
share: Publishes the roadmap or brain map as a private page for the team or, without internal details, for a client. Use for "comparte el roadmap", "enséñale el plan al cliente", "publica el mapa".
screenshots: Store screenshots - capture by deep link, frame at Google Play and App Store sizes with captions per language. Use for "capturas para la tienda", "screenshots de la ficha", "imágenes de Play/App Store".
photos: Product photos from your real photos, free and local - background removal, white store packshots, cutouts, brand backgrounds and ads per language in the DS colours. Use for "fotos de producto", "quita el fondo", "fondo blanco", "packshot".
agents: Lists the specialist agents (installed or not, what each does) and hands a task to one. Use for /dualcraft:agents, "¿qué agentes hay?", "lista los agentes", "/dualcraft:agents <agente> <tarea>".
flags: Feature flags and remote config from one catalog - typed accessors per stack with safe defaults and test overrides, Firebase Remote Config template or Supabase table, expired and unused flag checks. Use for "feature flag", "remote config", "activar sin publicar", "kill switch", "test A/B".
monitoring: Error and crash monitoring set up the same way on every app - Sentry or Crashlytics with shared release name, sample rate, consent and data scrubbing, symbol upload in CI and checks. Use for "monitorización de errores", "Sentry", "Crashlytics", "quiero enterarme de los crashes".
links: Deep links from one spec - typed link builders and parsers per stack, App Links and Universal Links files (.well-known), platform snippets, and checks that push and screenshots link to real routes. Use for "deep link", "enlace que abra la app", "universal links", "app links", "compartir enlace".
store: Store upload with fastlane - the store listing, release notes and framed screenshots per language exported to fastlane and uploaded to Google Play and App Store Connect by the release workflow, never submitting for review. Use for "fastlane", "sube la ficha a la tienda", "actualizar la ficha de Play / App Store".
graph: Code graph of every stack - find where a symbol is, who uses it, what a change affects, which files matter for a task, and where shared contracts are used on web and mobile, without reading the whole codebase. Use for "¿dónde se usa…?", "¿qué afecta cambiar…?", "¿dónde está…?", or before exploring code for a task.
